name: Multiplayer
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Online co-op: a Multiplayer item in the title's main menu, under Load Game, whose pages (the game's own menus) list the games others host, create one from a save or a new game, join one by its code, or play without a server with Direct connect. The host's Start starts the game for everyone: all play in the host's level, see each other's Ratchets, and share its world (its enemies go for the nearest player, a hit on one counts for all, crates and kills are shared, bolts go to whoever collects them).

settings.name: Server
settings.description: The OpenRAC server to connect to, as host:port (7770 when no port is given).

settings.name: Name
settings.description: Your name in multiplayer: 3 to 16 letters, digits or underscores. Defaults to the launcher's Multiplayer name.
